answer: On an island, an energy market must not let an ember of real generation become a gale of fake agent claims. Pay against a utility meter's signed cumulative export counter, storing the highest counter already settled for that meter. Each atomic settlement pays only the positive increase; cloned agents presenting the same reading earn nothing extra. Meter replacement must carry forward its settlement history. This ties rewards to measured electricity rather than identities, assuming trustworthy meters and utility checks against energy recirculation.
